boundary: GlobalConfig.save is the commit-point region: FrontpageSettings.resolveWeblog's read (and the inner getWeblogByHandle read it triggers) run before any write, so they auto-commit outside the unit under JPAPersistenceStrategy's lazy begin; the lazy transaction actually begins at JPAPropertiesManagerImpl.saveProperties' first strategy.store(prop) call (GlobalConfig.java:143) and commits at WebloggerFactory.getWeblogger().flush() (GlobalConfig.java:144). invalidateRenderedContent (line 149) runs after the flush, outside the transaction, and only clears in-memory caches.

ops_fix.note: JPAPropertiesManagerImpl.saveProperties (JPAPropertiesManagerImpl.java:142-149) is called only with the Map<String, RuntimeConfigProperty> built by getProperties/GlobalConfig.save; its loop variable is declared Object (line 260) so the extractor lost the static type, but the map's value type is RuntimeConfigProperty, mapped to roller_properties (RuntimeConfigProperty.orm.xml:25, weblogger package).
